name: Sterling-Nakamura Identity Verification Pendant IVP-2
description: A pendant-worn device that verifies the identity of anyone within 2 meters by cross-referencing their biometric emissions — facial geometry, body heat pattern, gait rhythm, and neural interface signature — against Sterling-Nakamura's identity database. The IVP-2 provides a subtle haptic notification to the wearer indicating whether a person's claimed identity matches their biometric profile. The device is designed for executives and diplomats who need to verify that the person they are meeting is who they claim to be, particularly in environments where ADM-1 disguise systems or Digital Twin impersonation might be in play.

specifications.info: heat pattern; gait; neural interface signature

story_hooks: An IVP-2 flagged a meeting participant as an identity anomaly — their biometrics did not match any profile in the database, meaning they are either unregistered or using an identity that does not correspond to any real person.
A sophisticated adversary has learned to spoof IVP-2 verification by replicating all four biometric channels simultaneously — the device confirms an identity that is entirely fabricated.
related_entities: Tessera Industries Adaptive Disguise Matrix ADM-1

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek pendant device resembling a polished gemstone or corporate seal, subtly angular with a slightly convex face. The form suggests precision engineering rather than jewelry — it reads as professional security tech disguised as luxury accessory. Approximately the size of a large coin or small pendant.
physical_description.dimensions: 4.5 cm height × 3.2 cm width × 1.8 cm depth (pendant form); can convert to 2.1 cm × 2.1 cm × 0.9 cm lapel pin configuration
physical_description.weight_description: Featherweight — 30 grams. Comfortably pocketable or wearable on chain without fatigue; designed for all-day corporate wear.
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed titanium alloy housing with sapphire crystal front lens
physical_description.finish: Matte metallic body with mirror-polished sapphire lens face; subtle iridescent coating on edges that shifts between gunmetal and deep blue under light
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray with accents of electric cyan and platinum; Sterling-Nakamura corporate silver trim
physical_description.interface_elements: Minimal — single raised cylindrical button (power/sync) on lower edge; tiny pinhole apertures for biometric sensors (thermal, optical) arranged in symmetrical pattern; subtle LED indicator ring (hidden beneath sapphire lens, visible only when active — glows soft cyan for verification pending, green for match confirmed, amber for identity anomaly)
distinctive_features: Sapphire crystal lens front with anti-reflective coating — appears almost invisible until light catches it
Embedded haptic motor produces distinct vibration patterns: single pulse (verified), double pulse (anomaly), sustained buzz (critical threat)
Barely-visible sensor array etched into titanium — only apparent at close inspection
Chain attachment loop reinforced with micro-magnetic coupling
Faint Sterling-Nakamura logo engraved on reverse in 2mm lettering
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Sterling-Nakamura corporate logo (interlocking S-N monogram) subtly engraved on rear; model number IVP-2 laser-marked on interior clasp; regulatory compliance stamps (GLMZ Data Authority approval, biometric privacy certification Φ) on tiny brass plate on chain
physical_description.condition_typical: Worn on thin platinum or steel chain around neck, or clipped to lapel via magnetic pin conversion. In active use, the lens catches light with faint cyan glow. Minor wear on chain contact points is common; sapphire resists scratching. Professional aesthetic — belongs in boardrooms and diplomatic venues.
